after_commit_message:
[OP-190] Add RPG.W14.6 Lv-80 capstone signature-ability runtime surface

Lock-only capstones are passive trophies. W14.6 wires the
"single signature ability" each Guild capstone is supposed to
embody at task time per ADR-0008 §"Talent tree (W14)".

Each capstone block in config/talent_tree.yaml now carries three
runtime fields beyond ability_id / display_name / summary:
* signature_label — routing keyword. capstone_routing_weight_multiplier
  applies +50% (ROUTING_WEIGHT_CAPSTONE_MATCH) on case-insensitive
  match, strictly larger than the per-talent +20% so the single
  Lv-80 ability outweighs any single fork. Shares
  OMNISIGHT_MP_TALENT_ROUTING_ENABLED with the W14.4 talent
  multiplier so one feature-flag flip lights up both effects.
* signature_prompt — multi-line block. prompt_builder.enrich_system_
  prompt_with_capstone injects it under a dedicated
  "Signature ability (per RPG.W14 capstone):" header — separate from
  "Talent reminders" so prompt-log readers can tell at a glance
  whether the agent is executing a Lv-80 signature move.
* commit_budget (optional) — operator-facing advisory commit ceiling
  appended to the prompt block. Canonical backend code_archaeologist
  carries commit_budget: 3 to encode the "≤ 3 commit" surgical-
  refactor discipline named in the ADR example.

Drift guard rejects a capstone block missing the required signature
fields at boot. Backwards-compat fallbacks (label = ability_id,
prompt = summary) keep older YAML loadable while the W11.1 schema
sweep migrates external Guild capstones forward.

Co-Authored-By: claude-bot <rt3628+claude-bot@gmail.com>
Co-Authored-By: nanakusa sora <rt3628@hotmail.com>
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Change-Id: Idcb84741e89431cf4b8dbe6ff83c513830a961ee
